articles.title: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed during police operation
articles.description: Police say Abdul Ballout was shot and killed after he rushed at officers with a knife in a western borough of Berlin.

articles.title: What we know so far about the Berlin Pride ramming attack
articles.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz condemns the attack as "heinous" after a suspect drove a car into a crowd near the Tiergarten park.

articles.title: Ten killed in Russian attack on drone exhibition near Kyiv
articles.description: The event, attended by prominent members of the Ukrainian defence industry, was hit by ballistic missiles in the middle of the day.

articles.title: Zelensky tries to fix crisis over removal of defence minister and counts the cost
articles.description: Protests have continued over Zelensky's decision to dismiss Mykhailo Fedorov, and some commentators believe he has been damaged politically.

articles.title: Iran-backed Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia
articles.description: US military says it disabled a tanker that was attempting to evade the American blockade on Iranian ports.

articles.title: Trump orders Smithsonian to post warnings about 'inaccurate' US history
articles.description: The Trump administration has often accused the world's largest research museum of harbouring an anti-American bias.

articles.title: Ebola cases in DR Congo surpass 3,000 - as health workers go on strike
articles.description: The Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has recorded more than 3,000 confirmed cases of Ebola, as it continues to battle the fastest-growing outbreak of the disease in history.
